chunks.l1:
## s01-v01 (1)
not / of-one-meditating / not / of-one-chanting / may-there-be / of-whom / without-preceding-rule / thus / indeed / Śiva-light / him / we-bow / bhakti-possessing
chunks.l2: Of one who neither meditates nor chants, manifestation may come without any preparatory rule. Just so — O light of Śiva — we bow to him who possesses devotion.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v01 — argument map

*na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam.* No meditation, no japa, no preparation — and yet the manifestation occurs. The stotra opens by denying method as precondition, not as practice.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v02 (2)
self / my / of-Your-devotion-nectar / by-drinking / young / though / being / of-world-journey / by-dust / of-passion / with-grey-hairs / as-if / dimmed
chunks.l2: My self stays young, drinking the nectar of Your devotion — though greyed as if with the dust of worldly journeying and its passions.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v02 — argument map

*ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san.* The self stays young drinking devotion-nectar while the body greys with world-dust. Youth = the self's nature; age = the journey's dust. (Lakshmanjoo: internally young.)

### Open
- v.2 *palitair iva dhūsaraḥ* — age vs weariness of travel; simile scope uncertain.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v03 (3)
of-those-who-have-gained / that / wealth / of-bhakti-possessors / in-Your-city / of-dwellers / movement / in-world-path / even / may-it-be / by-that-very / expansion
chunks.l2: For those who have gained that wealth — the possessors of devotion dwelling in Your city — even movement along worldly paths happens by that very expansion.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v03 — argument map

*labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām.* For wealth-holders dwelling in Your city, even worldly movement happens by that same expansion. The world is not abandoned; it is moved in differently.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v04 (4)
directly / consisting-of-You / O-Lord / in-all / within-the-world / what / not / of-bhakti-possessors / field / mantra / of-whom / not / succeeds
chunks.l2: Lord — where the whole world within worlds directly consists of You, what is not the devotee's field, and whose mantra does not succeed?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v04 — argument map

*sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare.* Where all the world is directly You, what is not the devotee's field, what mantra fails? Omnipresence converts the whole world into ritual ground.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v05 (5)
victorious / of-bhakti-nectar-rasa / with-the-best-wine / intoxicated / non-dual / though / always / Your / second / though / O-Lord
chunks.l2: Victory to those intoxicated with the finest wine of devotion's nectar-essence! Though non-dual, they are ever Your second, O Lord.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v05 — argument map

*jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ.* Victory to the intoxicated — drunk on the best wine, devotion-nectar. Intoxication is praise, not blame: it names excess of love.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v06 (6)
of-endless-bliss / of-the-ocean / of-You / O-Lord / truth / know / they / such / indeed / those-who / in-dense / bhakti-bliss-nectar / drenched
chunks.l2: Lord of the ocean of endless bliss — only they know Your truth who are densely drenched in blissful devotion's nectar.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v06 — argument map

*anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te.* Only the densely drenched know the ocean. Knowledge here is immersion-depth, not information. (Restricts 1.4: all is field, but only the drowned know.)

chunks.l1:
## s01-v07 (7)
You / indeed / O-Lord-of-self / of-all / all / and / in-self / attached / thus / as-self-established / Your-devotion / knowing / may-he-conquer / man
chunks.l2: You alone, Lord of the self, are the nature of all, and all loves dwelling in the self. Knowing Your devotion as self-established (*svabhāvasiddhā*) — by immersion's means — may a person conquer.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v07 — argument map

*tvam evātmeśa sarvasya... iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ.* THE CENTER. All desire the self; You alone are everyone's conscious self; hence devotion to You is self-established — and one who knows it **by immersion's means** (*samāveśayuktyā*, Kṣemarāja) conquers, i.e., lives supreme. The liṅ (*jayet*) is injunctive (Kṣemarāja: *niyoge liṅ*). Argument: since the object is the self, love of it needs no external ground.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v08 (8)
O-Lord / of-the-knowable / on-destruction / by-whom / not / seen / alone / standing / of-knower-and-knowable / in-agitation / even / you-are / by-devotees / easily-seen
chunks.l2: Lord — when the knowable is destroyed, by whom are You not seen, standing alone? Even amid the agitation of knower and knowable, You are easily seen by devotees.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v08 — argument map

*nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ.* When the knowable is destroyed, who does not see You standing alone? Negation as vision: remove objects, the subject stands revealed. Even amid knower/knowable agitation, devotees see easily (*sudṛśanaḥ*) — ease contrasts yogic difficulty (anticipates 16–17).

chunks.l1:
## s01-v09 (9)
of-endless-bliss / lake / goddess / beloved / as / inseparable / exists / from-You / thus / one / Your-devotion / may-it-be / mine
chunks.l2: As the lake of endless bliss, the Goddess, the beloved, is inseparable from You — so may one devotion of mine be inseparable.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v09 — argument map

*anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā.* As the beloved Goddess is inseparable from You, so may one devotion be mine. The devotee asks for non-separation modeled on the divine couple itself.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v10 (10)
all / indeed / of-gaining-You / cause / of-bhakti-possessors / O-all-pervading / consciousness-path / this / with-joy / suffering / delusion / threefold / standing
chunks.l2: O All-pervading — for devotees of devotion, everything is a cause of gaining You. This path of consciousness stands threefold — in joy, in suffering, in delusion.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v10 — argument map

*sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho.* For devotees everything causes gain of You; the consciousness-path stands threefold in joy, suffering, delusion. All three guṇa-states become path — nothing excluded.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v11 (11)
of-Your-devotion / nectar / by-tasting / of-knowledge / may-there-be / supreme / even / that / state / that / toward-me / with-respect-to / O-husband-Lord / of-vinegar / as-if / sourness
chunks.l2: What of knowledge — even its supreme state, from tasting Your devotion's nectar — is to me, O husband-Lord, like vinegar-sourness after wine.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v11 — argument map

*bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā daśā.* Even the supreme state of knowledge tastes, to me, like vinegar-sourness after wine beside devotion-nectar. Knowledge is not denied; it is out-tasted. (Lakshmanjoo's "Have you ever tasted liquor?" — the verse demands experience, not assent.)

chunks.l1:
## s01-v12 (12)
of-Your-devotion / great-knowledge / of-those / to-practice / has-come / of-knowledge / of-non-knowledge / of-both / even / those / these / knowers-of-truth
chunks.l2: Those to whom the great knowledge of Your devotion has come through practice — they alone know truth, both knowledge and its absence.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v12 — argument map

*bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā.* Those who have practiced devotion's great knowledge discriminate knowledge from non-knowledge. Discrimination is the fruit of practice, not its precondition (answers the scholar's objection).

chunks.l1:
## s01-v13 (13)
from-the-root / speech / creeper / this / unfolding-in-sequence / possessing-expansion / by-Your-devotion-nectar / watered / of-that / with-rasa-rich / fruits / may-it-be / for-me
chunks.l2: From the root, this creeper of speech, unfolding in due sequence — watered by the nectar of Your devotion, may it bear rasa-rich fruit for me.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v13 — argument map

*āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī.* The speech-creeper, unfolding in sequence from the root, watered by devotion-nectar — may it fruit for me. Speech itself grows and fruits; mantra is organic, not mechanical. (The four levels parā/paśyantī/madhyamā/vaikharī are Lakshmanjoo's gloss — NOT in the text; mark supplied in L2.)

### Open
- v.13 *vāk-latā* four-level mapping (parā/paśyantī/madhyamā/vaikharī) is Lakshmanjoo's supply; the text says only root-to-sequence unfolding. Mark supplied in L2.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v14 (14)
Śiva / having-become / let-him-worship / thus / devotee / having-become / thus / is-said / You / indeed / for / body / essence / by-devotees / by-nonduality / purified
chunks.l2: "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — so the devotee is said to have become. For You alone are the body's essence, purified by devotees through non-duality.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v14 — argument map

*śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate.* "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — and the devotee is *said* to have become. Scripture's paradox resolved by reported transformation: the Veda declares the devotee already become, and the body is refined by non-dual examination (*advayaśodhitam*).

chunks.l1:
## s01-v15 (15)
of-devotees / of-nonduality-with-You / for-accomplishment / what / not / proofs / for-its-non-accomplishment / of-the-low / what / not / obstructions / indeed
chunks.l2: For devotees, what is not a means to accomplishment of non-duality with You? And for the low, what obstructions could there be to its failure?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v15 — argument map

*bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ.* For devotees, what is not a means to non-duality with You? Even going astray leads there (Lakshmanjoo). And for the low, what obstructions to its failure? Double assurance: no wrong way, no blocked person.

### Open
- v.15 *nikṛṣṭānāṃ... kāni nāvaraṇāni* — "obstructions for the low": genuine universality or rhetorical assurance? Open; do not systematize.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v16 (16)
sometime / somewhere / attainable / you-are / by-yoga / thus / O-Lord / deceit / otherwise / in-all-states / you-shine / of-bhakti-possessors / how
chunks.l2: That You are attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga, O Lord — that is the deceit. Otherwise, how would You shine in all states for the possessors of devotion?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v16 — argument map

*kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā.* Attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga (thought-constriction, e.g., in the heart-wheel — Kṣemarāja) — this is **the deceit**. Proof: otherwise how do You shine in ALL states, including post-samādhi emergence, for devotees? The polemic verse: localization refutes itself.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v17 (17)
by-withdrawal / etc. / untouched / distinction / exists / great / this / than-yogins / of-devotion-sharers / since / in-emergence / even / composed
chunks.l2: Untouched by withdrawal and the rest — this is the great distinction: that sharers of devotion stay composed even in emergence, beyond the yogins.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v17 — argument map

*pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam.* The great distinction, untouched by withdrawal etc.: devotees stay composed even in emergence (*vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ*), yogins do not. The test is not ecstasy but return.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v18 (18)
not / yoga / not / austerity / not / worship-procedure / any / even / is-enjoined / in-guileless / on-Śiva-path / in-this / devotion / alone / is-praised
chunks.l2: No yoga is enjoined, no austerity, no procedure of worship at all. On this guileless path of Śiva, devotion alone is praised.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v18 — argument map

*na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate.* No yoga, no austerity, no worship-procedure is enjoined; on this guileless Śiva-path, devotion alone is praised. The amāya (guileless) path needs no technique because its means is love.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v19 (19)
from-all-sides / by-shining / bhakti / light / of-shattered / covering / of-me / of-directly-faced / all-things / of-thoughts / even / may-perish
chunks.l2: My covering shattered by devotion's light shining from all sides — may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v19 — argument map

*sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama.* My covering shattered by all-radiant devotion-light; may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish. Covering destroyed from all sides at once — then even thought, facing reality directly, ends.

### Open
- v.19 *cintānām api naśyatu* — whose thoughts perish, and is thought's end extinction or facing (*pratyakṣa*)? Left open.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v20 (20)
Śiva / thus / of-one-word / of-tongue / on-tip / standing / always / of-all / sense-objects / taste / in-devotees / indeed / exists / what / even / wonder
chunks.l2: A wonder: that in devotees, with the single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue's tip, there is the taste of every sense-object.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v20 — argument map

*śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā.* The single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue-tip: devotees taste by it every sense-object — a wonder (*aho*). The Name delivers all senses, not just sound. (Lakshmanjoo: nectar of touch, embrace, smell — ethically risky rendering; keep to "every sense-object's taste" in L2.)

### Open
- v.20 Lakshmanjoo's sensory expansion (touch/embrace/smell) exceeds the text's *samastaviṣayāsvāda*; rein in L2.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v21 (21)
in-calm-waved / cool / clear / sweet / bhakti-nectar / ocean / in-unworldly / rasa / taste / by-the-firm / who / nameless / is-counted
chunks.l2: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet milk-ocean of devotion's nectar — in tasting its unworldly essence — who that stands firm there is counted low?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v21 — argument map

*śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau.* Who counts as low who stands firm tasting the unworldly rasa, diving the calm-waved cool sweet devotion-milk-ocean? Status inverted: divers, not scholars, rank high.

### Open
- anāma crux: nameless (mystic) vs of-no-account (social); L2 takes mystic, alternative recorded in L0.

### Gloss adjudications
- s01-v21-p011: chose option 0 over of-no-account, infamous — L2 keeps the mystic register (the diver, not the dropout); the social reading survives as the live alternative — crux left open per C1 boundary, do not freeze.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v22 (22)
by-equals / why / not / should-be-chewed / Your-devotion / great-medicine / such / O-Lord / of-which / liberation-named / uninterrupted / rasa
chunks.l2: Why would people like me not chew Your devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste, O Lord, is called liberation?
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v22 — argument map

*sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ.* Why would people like me not chew devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste is named liberation? Medicine, not dessert: it cures, with liberation as after-taste (*anantara rasa*), not wages.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v23 (23)
those / indeed / is-valued-as-supreme / wealths / by-the-good / O-Lord / which / of-Your / bhakti-rasa / enjoyment / of-confident-enjoyment / nourishing
chunks.l2: Those alone are ultimately wealth, O Lord, in the judgement of the good — which nourish confident enjoyment of the taste of devotion to You.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v23 — argument map

*tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ.* True wealth, the good agree, is only what nourishes confident enjoyment of devotion-nectar. Wealth redefined: whatever feeds enjoyment of the rasa.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v24 (24)
of-Your-devotion-nectar / essence / by-them / what / even / grasped / who / not / in-passion / etc. / in-mud / in-this / are-smeared / fallen / though
chunks.l2: They have grasped something of Your devotion-nectar's essence who, though fallen into this mud of passion and the rest, are not smeared by it.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v24 — argument map

*bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ.* They have grasped devotion-nectar's essence who, fallen even into passion's mud, are not smeared. Falling without staining: the world entered without adhesion.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v25 (25)
among-powers-beginning-with-aṇimā / ending-with-liberation / among-limbs / indeed / fruit / called / of-Your-devotion / of-ripened / of-creeper / as-it-were / in-some / indeed
chunks.l2: From supernormal powers to liberation — "fruit" is named as a mere limb of the ripened creeper of Your devotion, for some.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v25 — argument map

*aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā.* From supernormal powers to liberation, fruits are named as mere limbs of the ripened devotion-creeper — for some. Even liberation is a limb, not the root; the creeper is the thing.

chunks.l1:
## s01-v26 (26)
wonder / by-nature / O-Lord / of-pain / seed / this / mind / by-Your-devotion-rasa / watered / of-liberation / great-fruit
chunks.l2: A wonder, Lord: this mind, by nature pain's seed — watered by the essence of devotion to You, becomes liberation's great fruit.
chunks.argmap:
## s01-v26 — argument map

*citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ.* Wonder: the mind, by nature pain's seed, watered by devotion-rasa becomes liberation's great fruit. Closes the arc: 1.2's dust-greyed mind returns transfigured — seed unchanged, watering changed, fruit opposite.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v01 (1)
of-fire-moon-sun-Brahmā-Viṣṇu-moving-unmoving / of-own-nature / to-many-formed / bow / of-consciousness-formed / to-You
chunks.l2: To the many-formed, whose nature is consciousness — fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, moving and unmoving — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v01 — argument map

Fire-moon-sun, Brahmā-Viṣṇu, moving-unmoving: to the many-formed, consciousness-formed — bow. The All invoked as elements AND gods at once; multiplicity is the address, not the problem.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v02 (2)
of-universe-fuel-great-ash-smeared-pure-shining / to-great-fire / to-Becoming / of-world-sole-oblation / bow
chunks.l2: To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure with great ash, to the Becoming to whom the world is the sole oblation — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v02 — argument map

To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure, the world's sole oblation. Sacrifice internalized: the world is fuel, the fire is Him.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v03 (3)
to-supreme-nectar-dense / to-cool / to-Śiva-fire / to-some / even / of-world-destroying-unequal / bow / be / to-You
chunks.l2: To Śiva-fire — cool, dense with supreme nectar — and to You, the unequalled devourer in the world's destruction — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v03 — argument map

To Śiva-fire: cool, supremely nectar-dense — and to You, the unequalled devourer of all. Coolness and devouring together; comfort and terror in one flame. (Lakshmanjoo ch.2 v.28 excerpt source.)

chunks.l1:
## s02-v04 (4)
to-Mahādeva / to-Rudra / to-Śaṅkara / to-Śiva / to-You / to-Maheśvara-even / bow / to-which / indeed / mantra-formed / bow
chunks.l2: To Mahādeva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva, to You Maheśvara — and to someone mantra-bodied — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v04 — argument map

To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva, Maheśvara — and to some mantra-bodied one. Named gods PLUS the unnamed ("someone mantra-formed"): the list refuses closure.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v05 (5)
bow / of-cut-dried-up-three-worlds-melted-fat-pouring-unequalled / to-auspicious / to-Śiva-fire
chunks.l2: To Śiva-fire — cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the oblation — unequalled, yet auspicious — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v05 — argument map

To Śiva-fire: cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the offering — unequalled, yet auspicious. Destruction language, auspiciousness kept.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v06 (6)
of-all-marks-meeting / indeed / of-which / mark / to-him / bow / be / to-god / to-some / indeed / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: To the god — to gracious someone — for whom the meeting of all marks is itself the mark — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v06 — argument map

To the god — to someone gracious — whose mark is just the non-meeting of all marks. The sign of Him: signlessness. (Lakshmanjoo: "perceiving Him in no way.")

chunks.l1:
## s02-v07 (7)
to-Veda-āgama-opposing / to-Veda-āgama-making / to-Veda-āgama-true-essence / to-hidden / to-master / bow
chunks.l2: To the hidden Lord — Veda-opposing, Veda-making, the Veda's true essence, secret master — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v07 — argument map

To the hidden Lord: Veda-opposing AND Veda-making, Veda's true essence, secret master. Scripture's author and its transgressor at once.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v08 (8)
of-saṃsāra-sole-cause / of-saṃsāra-sole-foe / bow / of-saṃsāra-formed / of-saṃsāra-free / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: Sole cause of the wheel of births and deaths — and its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed, saṃsāra-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v08 — argument map

Sole cause of saṃsāra AND its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed AND saṃsāra-free. Fourfold contradiction in one breath; the cause/foe pair is the engine verse. (Lakshmanjoo: "the only cause... of this torture.")

chunks.l1:
## s02-v09 (9)
to-root / to-middle / to-tip / to-root-middle-tip-formed / to-tip-middle-root-dissolved / bow / to-full / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: To root, to middle, to tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted — to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v09 — argument map

To root, middle, tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted; to the Full. Time's three points run forward, then backward, then out — exhaustion as fullness.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v10 (10)
bow / of-merit-heap-ripening / even-once / also / also / of-whom / by-name-taking / to-him / hard-to-find / to-Śiva / to-You
chunks.l2: Even once — whosever taking of the Name — ripened heaps of merit. To You, Śiva, hard to attain — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v10 — argument map

Even once, whoever takes His name: ripened merit-heaps. Grace-economics: a single utterance outbids accumulated merit; rarity (*durlabha*) with open access.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v11 (11)
bow / with-moving-unmoving-multitude-heaps / always / sporting / to-You-alone / one / to-consciousness-formed / to-skull-bearer
chunks.l2: To You alone — consciousness-formed, skull-bearing — ever sporting with heaped multitudes of moving-and-static forms — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v11 — argument map

To the One playing, consciousness-formed, skull-bearing, with multitudes of moving-static forms ever heaped around. Play (*krīḍā*) as His mode; the skull-bearer amid crowds, not apart.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v12 (12)
to-magician / to-pure / to-hidden / to-self-manifest / to-subtle / to-all-formed / bow / to-wondrous / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: To the magician, the pure, the hidden, the self-manifest; the subtle, the all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v12 — argument map

Magician yet pure, hidden yet self-manifest, subtle yet all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu, bow. Six paradoxes, no resolution offered; the list IS the theology.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v13 (13)
by-Brahmā-Indra-Viṣṇu-arrayed / world-destroying-play / to-wonder-working / bow / to-You / O-all-power
chunks.l2: To all power — whose play destroys the Brahmā-Viṣṇu-arrayed world — wonder-working — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v13 — argument map

To all-power: Brahmā-Viṣṇu-arrayed world's destroyer-play, wonder-working. Destruction as play (*kelī*), not wrath.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v14 (14)
on-shores / indeed / by-wandering / gained / those / those / powers / of-whom / to-him / bow / to-You / O-unfathomable-Hara-ocean
chunks.l2: To You, the fathomless Hara-ocean — whose powers are gained by those wandering only its shores — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v14 — argument map

To the fathomless Hara-ocean: powers gained only by those wandering its shores. Stay on the shore — the powers are littoral, the ocean itself is beyond grasping. (Lakshmanjoo: "unlimited ocean... on whose shores.")

chunks.l1:
## s02-v15 (15)
to-Māyā-made-world-dense-mud-dwelling / to-unsmeared / bow / O-Śambhu-lotus / to-shining
chunks.l2: To the lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus, dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared, shining — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v15 — argument map

Dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared — to lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus. Cf. 1.24's unstained; the lotus gives the image.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v16 (16)
to-auspicious / to-pure / to-treasure / to-ornament-self / to-dear / to-supreme-real / to-highest / to-You / bow
chunks.l2: Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — to You — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v16 — argument map

Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — bow. Pure auspiciousness catalogue; no paradox this time — rest before the hard verses.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v17 (17)
bow / to-ever-bound / to-ever-freedom-sharing / to-bondage-freedom-less / to-whomsoever / indeed / even / also / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: Ever bound, ever sharing liberation's portion; difference-free — to gracious someone Śambhu — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v17 — argument map

To ever-bound AND ever-liberated; to difference-free gracious Śambhu. The stanza's impossibility held without blinking. (Lakshmanjoo's stressed paradox.)

chunks.l1:
## s02-v18 (18)
in-mockery-essence-only / in-this / in-all-this / in-three-worlds / to-You-alone / indeed / to-non-dual / bow / to-ever-bliss-seated
chunks.l2: In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You alone, secondless, ever-bliss-seated — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v18 — argument map

In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You, secondless, ever-bliss-seated. The world demoted to joke; He alone serious. Pivot of the song.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v19 (19)
of-right-practice-essence / of-left-practice-desiring / to-all-practices / to-Śarva / to-practiceless / to-You / bow
chunks.l2: Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, to observance-free Śarva — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v19 — argument map

Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, observance-free. Rites affirmed and exceeded in one line. (Lakshmanjoo: "essence of dakṣiṇācāra.")

chunks.l1:
## s02-v20 (20)
as / however / who / worshipped / where / there / even / who / worshipped / who / even / or / he / even / or / who / that / god / to-him / bow / be / to-You
chunks.l2: Whoever is worshipped, however, wherever — and whoever, whatever god he be — to that god, bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v20 — argument map

Whoever worshipped, however, wherever, whatever god — to that god, bow. Total ritual hospitality: no wrong address, since all reach Him.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v21 (21)
by-liberation-seekers-served / of-all-burning-removing / bow / to-spread-loveliness-best / to-boon-giving / to-You
chunks.l2: Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness — to You, boon-giver — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v21 — argument map

Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness, boon-giver. Austerity (tapas-heat) cooled by beauty.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v22 (22)
always / of-unbroken-bliss-rasa-filled-all-three-worlds / bow / to-You / O-husband-Lord / of-ever-festival
chunks.l2: To You, husband-Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v22 — argument map

To the husband-Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa. Festival not occasion but ontology.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v23 (23)
of-pleasure-first / knowables-enjoying / worships / and / which / You / indeed / to-that / terrible / host-of-powers / to-You / bow
chunks.l2: What enjoys You in pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of Your powers — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v23 — argument map

What enjoys You in pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of powers, bow. Striking turn: salutation redirected from Him to His terrible energies who enjoy Him. Devotion includes the fearful retinue.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v24 (24)
of-sages / even / unknown / devotion-touched / gestures / embrace / even / whom / to-that / to-some / indeed / to-Becoming / bow
chunks.l2: Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures love connects embrace Him. To that someone Becoming — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v24 — argument map

Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures LOVE connects embrace Him. To that someone, bow. Knowing fails; embracing works; love outranks asceticism. (Anticipates 1.17's yogin/devotee cut from the other side.)

chunks.l1:
## s02-v25 (25)
of-supreme-nectar / store / of-supreme-nectar / heap / of-all / of-beyond / of-non-beyond / to-be-reached / to-Becoming / bow
chunks.l2: To the supreme-nectar sheath, the supreme-nectar heap; reachable beyond far and near — to Becoming — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v25 — argument map

To the supreme-nectar sheath, supreme-nectar heap, reachable beyond far and near. Nectar stored AND heaped; distance categories collapse.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v26 (26)
made-of-great-mantra / I-praise / form / of-You / clear-cool / unprecedented-joy-fortunate / supreme-nectar-juicy
chunks.l2: I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v26 — argument map

I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form. The mantra IS His body; praise of form is praise of sound.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v27 (27)
of-autonomy-nectar-full / of-oneness-fame / in-great-cloth / wonder / not / is / indeed / where / O-Lord / that / I-praise / Your / teaching
chunks.l2: On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v27 — argument map

On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching. Non-wonder as doctrine: once oneness is spread out, marvels stop being marvelous.

chunks.l1:
## s02-v28 (28)
of-all-doubts-thunderbolt / of-all-fortunes-fire / likewise / of-all-inauspicious-ending / path / of-Maheśvara / we-bow
chunks.l2: Thunderbolt to all doubt, fire to all fortune, world's-end to all inauspiciousness — we bow the Māheśvara path.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v28 — argument map

Thunderbolt to all doubt, fire to all fortune, world's-end to all inauspiciousness — we bow the Māheśvara path. The path itself praised as weapon; protection by awe. (Quoted in Academy blog, ch.2 v.28.)

chunks.l1:
## s02-v29 (29)
victory / O-god / bow / bow / be / to-You / all / world / this / of-You / resting-on / of-worlds / O-supreme-Lord / You-are / supreme-one / to-refuge-gone / am / to-You
chunks.l2: Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme.
chunks.argmap:
## s02-v29 — argument map

Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme. Litany closes into refuge (*śaraṇāgata*) — contemplation ends in surrender.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v01 (1)
being / by-non-being-ness / of-beings / endowed / which / twofold / course / that / having-leapt-beyond / to-the-third / bow / to-the-wondrous / to-Śambhu
chunks.l2: Of things, the two courses that go by being and non-being — leaping over them — to the third, the wondrous Śambhu — bow.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v01 — argument map

*sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ.* The two courses of things — by being and non-being — leapt over; to the third, the wondrous Śambhu, bow. Method stated: transcendence by leap, not ladder.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v02 (2)
of-gods / seer / from-men / in-this / in-the-unfree / world / in-triad / free / they / of-the-free / who / of-You / indeed / dependents
chunks.l2: Among gods, seers, and men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, O Free One.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v02 — argument map

*āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye.* Among gods, seers, men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, the Free One's own. Freedom is contagious, not achieved. (Lakshmanjoo: all dependent, Your men free.)

chunks.l1:
## s03-v03 (3)
whole / universe / inlaid / Your / body / remembrance / of-whom / of-becoming / of-pains / one / medicine / they / happily / seated
chunks.l2: Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the one medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v03 — argument map

*aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ.* Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the sole medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy. Memory as cure.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v04 (4)
white / umbrella / of-whom / moon / own / light / filled / fly-whisk / heaven-river / stream / he / alone / supreme-lord
chunks.l2: Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v04 — argument map

*sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ.* Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord. Cosmic regalia; kingship by metaphor.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v05 (5)
luminous / cool / one / pure / moon / digit / as / glance / grant / to-me / O-Lord / some / even / nectar / bearing
chunks.l2: Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as a moon-digit, carrying nectar.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v05 — argument map

*prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ... dṛśaṃ vitara me.* Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as moon-digit, carrying nectar. The begged glance; grace as look. (Lakshmanjoo: "I want only one glance of Thee.")

chunks.l1:
## s03-v06 (6)
Your / consciousness / bliss / from-ocean / fallen / knowings / drops / these / why / for-me / O-Lord / not / nectar / taste / beautiful
chunks.l2: Fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings, these drops — why are they not nectar-sweet-beautiful to me, Lord?
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v06 — argument map

*tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ.* Drops fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings — why aren't they nectar-sweet-beautiful to me? The devotee interrogates his own dryness.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v07 (7)
in-You / love / in-rasa / O-Lord / not / merged / heart / O-ruler / of-whom / not / hearted / indeed / they / contempt / abode / such
chunks.l2: In Your love-rasa, Lord, hearts unmelted — the heartless alone — such deserve contempt.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v07 — argument map

*tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ.* Hearts unmelted in Your love-rasa are heartless indeed — fit for contempt. Hard verse: unmelted = contemptible. Do not soften.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v08 (8)
by-the-lord / by-You / whose / arisen / heart / meeting / of-ruling-goddesses / of-powers / supreme / alone / he / vessel
chunks.l2: Whose heart has met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v08 — argument map

*prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam.* Whose heart met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers. Union makes the devotee the gods' container — inversion of worship direction.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v09 (9)
of-joys / now / of-sorrows / of-all / flooder / alike / Your / meditation / nectar / flood / low / non-low / of-lands / as
chunks.l2: Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v09 — argument map

*harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam.* Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling. Feeling levelled, not sorted.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v10 (10)
what / as-it-were / not / may-it-be / with-glance / of-them / happiness / provisions / full / of-whom / self / by-greater / O-Lord / not / where / even / separation / from-You
chunks.l2: What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord?
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v10 — argument map

*keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā.* What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord? Lifers (*ātmādhikena*...): separation impossible. (Lakshmanjoo: "more than their own lives.")

chunks.l1:
## s03-v11 (11)
I-roar / ah / I-dance / fulfilled / of-me / mind / chariots / lord / my / this / won / since / you / utterly / charming
chunks.l2: I roar, I dance — my wishes are fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v11 — argument map

*garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ.* I roar, I dance — my wishes fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming. Ecstasy as evidence: roar and dance prove arrival.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v12 (12)
not / other / knowable / action / where / not / other / yoga / by-knowing / and / which / knowledge / may-it-be / what / but / universe / one / full / consciousness / you / expands
chunks.l2: Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v12 — argument map

*nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo.* Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands. Anti-method peak: nothing to know, nowhere to yoke — and yet expansion.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v13 (13)
hard / of-conquerable / of-endless / of-sorrows / suddenly / indeed / of-them / from-hand / fled / of-whom / in-speech / forever / Śiva / sound
chunks.l2: Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v13 — argument map

*durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te.* Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound. The Name as exorcist; sorrows flee sound, not argument.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v14 (14)
highest / person / other / is / You / by-remainder / distinguished / you / great / person / but / alone / remainderless / of-persons / support
chunks.l2: Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v14 — argument map

*uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti.* Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder. No second — with the devotee-residue kept ("remaining Yours").

chunks.l1:
## s03-v15 (15)
they-conquer / they / world / venerable / servants / Your / of-worlds / O-pervader / transmigration / ocean / indeed / this / of-whom / play / great / lake
chunks.l2: Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v15 — argument map

*jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te.* Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake. Ocean shrunk to lake by servitude. (Lakshmanjoo's "victorious... Thy slaves.")

chunks.l1:
## s03-v16 (16)
let-sit / meanwhile / other / miseries / here / You / of-devotees / you / indeed / manifest / may-you-be / thus / by-this / indeed / is-shamed
chunks.l2: Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v16 — argument map

*āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām.* Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed. His manifestation shames misery; no refutation needed.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v17 (17)
than-me / beyond / not / is / therein / even / reciter / I-am / that / by-oneness / in-truth / recitation / thus / beads / by-rosary / you-point / where / indeed
chunks.l2: "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v17 — argument map

*matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ.* "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere. Recitation continues inside supremacy; the rosary pointed by Him.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v18 (18)
of-being / necessarily / supreme / being / being / and / than-that / beyond / O-ruler / you / and / from-non-being / of-being / and / other / therefore / you-are / being / non-being / formed
chunks.l2: From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v18 — argument map

*sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat.* From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed. The metaphysical knot, tied openly. Do not untie in L2.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v19 (19)
thousand / sun / ray / exceeding / pure / shining / even / you / all / worlds / pervading / even / not / you-are-seen
chunks.l2: Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v19 — argument map

*sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān.* Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen. Maximum light, zero visibility: the paradox of immanence. (Lakshmanjoo's stressed verse.)

chunks.l1:
## s03-v20 (20)
in-the-inert / in-the-world / consciousness / formed / indeed / in-the-knowable / even / knower / mighty / in-the-measured / and / by-which / you-are / by-that / all / highest / you
chunks.l2: Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v20 — argument map

*jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ.* Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest. Pervasion logic: great-by-containing, not by exceeding.

chunks.l1:
## s03-v21 (21)
enough / with-cries / with-others / this-much / indeed / before / of-the-Lord / sharply / I-cry-aloud / which / O-Lord / I-am-bewildered / thus / knowing / even
chunks.l2: Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus.
chunks.argmap:
## s03-v21 — argument map

*alam ākranditair anyair.* Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus. Close: knowing bewilderment, crying anyway. (Lakshmanjoo: let other lamentations lie untouched.)

chunks.l1:
## s04-v01 (1)
fickle / you-are / since / even / O-mind / therein / even / you-are-praised / since / you-worship / of-refuges / even / refuge / triple-world / teacher / Ambikā / husband
chunks.l2: Mind — though fickle you are — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v01 — argument map

*capalam asi yad api mānasa.* Mind, though fickle — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband. Fickleness forgiven for direction: praise for turning, not for steadiness. (Lakshmanjoo addresses his own mind throughout.)

chunks.l1:
## s04-v02 (2)
having-crossed / various / gods / ladder / course / having-approached / Śiva / feet / having-resorted / even / lower / ground / not / now / even / wonder / I-quit
chunks.l2: Having crossed the ladder-steps of various gods, reached Śiva's feet — yet on the lowest ground I stand even now; wonder, I do not quit it.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v02 — argument map

*ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam.* Having crossed the ladder-steps of various gods, reached Śiva's feet — yet on the lowest ground I stand even now; wonder, I do not quit it. Arrival without departure: highest object, lowest seat, no contradiction felt.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v03 (3)
reveal / own / path / hide / fully / all / world / doings / while / I-am / O-Lord / of-You / quickly / ever / risen / servant
chunks.l2: Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v03 — argument map

*prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām.* Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant. Double imperative: show Yours, cover theirs; use me now (*sapadi*).

chunks.l1:
## s04-v04 (4)
Śiva / Śiva / O-Śambhu / O-Śaṅkara / refuge-come / loving / swiftly / make / pity / Your / feet / lotus / pair / remembrance / intent-on / indeed / fortunes / not / far
chunks.l2: Śiva Śiva Śambhu Śaṅkara — swift pity on the refuge-seekers' lover! Fortune is near for whoever remembers Your lotus-feet-pair.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v04 — argument map

*śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara.* Śiva Śiva Śambhu Śaṅkara — swift pity on the refuge-seekers' lover! Fortune is near for whoever remembers Your lotus-feet-pair. Name-piling as spell; mercy as speed (*āśu*).

chunks.l1:
## s04-v05 (5)
Your / foot / lotus / throne / seated / who / as / liking / world / they-create / they / Brahmā / office / by-stain / smeared / not / own / controlled / O-Lord / they-laugh
chunks.l2: Those seated on Your foot-lotus-throne, making the world to taste — they laugh at Vir iñc, office-stained, not-self-ruled.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v05 — argument map

*tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā.* Those seated on Your foot-lotus-throne, making the world to taste — they laugh at Vir iñc (Brahmā), office-stained, not-self-ruled. Devotees laugh at the creator: office (*adhikāra*) stains, throne-sitting frees.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v06 (6)
Your / light / from-body / not / apart / divided / what / at-all / prevails / to-appear / that / ever / indeed / O-Lord / fully / gained / you-are / O-Lord / by-nature / even / far
chunks.l2: Nothing appears apart from Your light-body; so You are always already gained, Lord — though far by nature.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v06 — argument map

*tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana.* Nothing appears apart from Your light-body; so You are always already gained, Lord — though far by nature. Immanence proved, transcendence kept: gained AND far.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v07 (7)
foot / lotus / juice / of-You / some / indeed / difference / stale / conduct / endowed / some / at-all / even / they-taste / but / instantly / shining / flawless / body / duality / void
chunks.l2: Some taste Your foot-lotus-juice as stale-difference-conduct; others instantly taste it as flawless, body-whole, duality-free.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v07 — argument map

*pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid.* Some taste Your foot-lotus-juice as stale-difference-conduct; others instantly taste it as flawless, body-whole, duality-free. Two tastes, one dust: stale vs fresh is the taster's, not the foot's.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v08 (8)
O-Lord / lightning / as / shines / at-dawn / which / when / at-all / of-me / nectar / smeared / she / if / steadier / indeed / may-it-be / that / worshipped / you-are / duly / what / or / other
chunks.l2: Lord, like lightning at dawn gleams my nectar-smeared — if it stayed steadier, You are worshipped duly — what else?
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v08 — argument map

*nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte.* Lord, like lightning at dawn gleams my nectar-smeared — if it stayed steadier, You are worshipped duly — what else? Flash-devotion: one steady flash would complete all rite. (Conditional worship: *if* it stayed.)

chunks.l1:
## s04-v09 (9)
all / of-this / beyond / is / not / what / indeed / thing / not / thing / if / or / thus / with-great / for-discernment / decided / here / as / indeed / you / so / indeed / be / very / manifest / for-me
chunks.l2: Is there anything, thing or non-thing, apart from this? With great discernment decided here: as You are, so be plain to me.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v09 — argument map

*sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid.* Is there anything, thing or non-thing, apart from this? With great discernment decided here: as You are, so be plain to me. Discernment (*prajñā*) issues in demand: appear as You are.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v10 (10)
own / by-will / indeed / O-Lord / own / on-path / made-to-do / step / I / by-lord / indeed / that / how / man / like / indeed / I-behave / Your / feet / fit / I-know / not / what / indeed
chunks.l2: By Your will alone, Lord, I was made to step on Your own path — then why do I behave just like a man, knowing nothing fit for Your feet?
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v10 — argument map

*svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam.* By Your will alone, Lord, I was made to step on Your own path — then why do I behave just like a man, knowing nothing fit for Your feet? Placed unasked (Lakshmanjoo's stressed point: "I never asked You... You have done it Yourself!"), yet behaving humanly — the complaint of the carried.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v11 (11)
some / even / god / in-heart / among-them / Yours / blooms / lovely / state / highest / Your / story / cloud / thunder / cātakas / by-whom / they / even / made-lovely / long
chunks.l2: Some god of Yours blooms in their hearts, a lovely supreme state — by whose story-thunder-cātakas they are long gladdened.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v11 — argument map

*ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate.* Some god of Yours blooms in their hearts, a lovely supreme state — by whose story-thunder-cātakas they are long gladdened. Devotion blooms unasked in some; story-rain gladdens long.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v12 (12)
You / of-devotees / in-You / by-some / even / play / love / this / to-fullness / arrived / since / separation / on-ground / talk / thus / memory / fruits / union / festival
chunks.l2: For Your devotees, by some play in You, this love has grown fat — so that separation-ground talk and memory fruit in union-festival.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v12 — argument map

*tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ.* For Your devotees, by some play in You, this love has grown fat — so that separation-ground talk and memory fruit in union-festival. Play grows love; separation-talk (*saṅkathā*) itself fruits in union.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v13 (13)
who / strange / rasa / sprinkling / grown / Śaṅkara / thus / by-hundreds / even / uttered / word / enters / sideways / in-hearts / even / this / ever / fresh / purposed
chunks.l2: The word, grown by strange-rasa-sprinkling, though uttered "Śaṅkara" hundreds of times — enters even sideways hearts, ever-fresh in purpose.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v13 — argument map

*yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ.* The word, grown by strange-rasa-sprinkling, though uttered "Śaṅkara" hundreds of times — enters even sideways hearts, ever-fresh in purpose. The Name penetrates the unwilling; freshness never stales.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v14 (14)
they / conquer / face / on-orb / revolving / is / in-whom / ever / Śiva / sound / who / moon / as / spread-forth / nectar / from-source / sweet / trickles / and / nectar / supreme
chunks.l2: Victorious are they on whose face-orbits the Śiva-sound ever revolves — which, moon-spread from nectar-source, trickles supreme nectar, sweet.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v14 — argument map

*te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman.* Victorious are they on whose face-orbits the Śiva-sound ever revolves — which, moon-spread from nectar-source, trickles supreme nectar, sweet. Faces win: sound on the mouth beats thought in the head.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v15 (15)
fully / finished / as / fierce / this / world / melted / not / sparse / of-mind / impurity / that / even / not / is / Your / city / bolt / door / knocking / atom / even
chunks.l2: The fierce world as if finished; mind's impurity thinned to none — and yet not even the smallest knocking at Your city-door-bolt.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v15 — argument map

*parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad.* The fierce world as if finished; mind's impurity thinned to none — and yet not even the smallest knocking at Your city-door-bolt. End of differentiation (Lakshmanjoo's Bruce Hughes passage) — yet no entry knocked. The door verse: realization without arrival. Do not resolve.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v16 (16)
ever / blooming / Your / face / lotus / interior / gaze / eager / of-mind / what / even / that / do / O-Lord / a-little / as / you-flash / by-which / of-me / facing / state
chunks.l2: Of minds eager for Your ever-blooming face-lotus-belly-gaze — do something, Lord, just a little, so You flash as facing me.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v16 — argument map

*satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ.* Of minds eager for Your ever-blooming face-lotus-belly-gaze — do something, Lord, just a little, so You flash as facing me. "Just a little" (*manāg iva*): the smallest turn asked.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v17 (17)
You / non-difference / than-mind / other / pray / what / happiness / here / is / glory / or / other / that / here / Your / servant / of-folk / what / bad / path / goes / mind / having-abandoned / her
chunks.l2: What happiness here apart from non-difference-mind, what other glory? So why does this servant's mind, abandoning her, go the wrong way?
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v17 — argument map

*tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham.* What happiness here apart from non-difference-mind, what other glory? So why does this servant's mind, abandoning her, go the wrong way? The song's self-accusation: knowing the answer, asking the question.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v18 (18)
moment / even / here / not / Your / serfdom / toward / may-I-be / I / indeed / vessel / being / non-difference / rasa / wine / reverently / unceasingly / may-I-taste / I / not / if
chunks.l2: May I never for a moment be unfit for Your serfdom — unless constantly, reverently tasting non-difference-wine.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v18 — argument map

*kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati.* May I never for a moment be unfit for Your serfdom — unless constantly, reverently tasting non-difference-wine. Fitness redefined as tasting-frequency.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v19 (19)
not / indeed / sees / truly / this / person / of-You / body / duality / by-sight / dirtied / that / even / all-knowing / resorted / fond / what / this / cry / not / you-hear / my
chunks.l2: These people truly do not see Your body, dirtied by duality-sight — and yet, all-knowing refuge-lover, do You not hear MY cry?
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v19 — argument map

*na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas.* These people truly do not see Your body, dirtied by duality-sight — and yet, all-knowing refuge-lover, do You not hear MY cry? Others' blindness conceded; his cry excepted. (Lakshmanjoo: "I confess it, my Lord.")

chunks.l1:
## s04-v20 (20)
you-remember / O-Lord / when / indeed / even / desired / sense / pleasure / and / even / by-me / asked / always / even / being / body / vision / nectar / wished / only / of-me / give / that
chunks.l2: Do You remember, Lord, any desired sense-pleasure I ever asked? Give instead, always, Your body-vision-nectar as the only wish.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v20 — argument map

*smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ* Do You remember, Lord, any desired sense-pleasure I ever asked? Give instead, always, Your body-vision-nectar as the only wish. Pleasures recalled only to be exchanged.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v21 (21)
indeed / when / indeed / Śiva / on-path / in-Yours / made / step / I-am / O-great-lord / Your / by-will / good / hundreds / arisen / then / indeed / for-me / what / other / I-seek / from-You / O-ruler
chunks.l2: Since by Your will alone I stepped on Your Śiva-path, Lord — hundreds of good omens rose for me; what else should I seek from You?
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v21 — argument map

*kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi.* Since by Your will alone I stepped on Your Śiva-path, Lord — hundreds of good omens rose for me; what else should I seek from You? Placed-ness (10) returns as contentment. (Lakshmanjoo: hundreds of good things.)

chunks.l1:
## s04-v22 (22)
where / he / setting / this / goes / sun / moon / beginning-with / with / all / what / even / she / shines-triumphant / Śiva / night / own / light / spreading / lustrous / formed
chunks.l2: Where the sun sets with the moon and all — that unconquered Śiva-night shines, self-light-spread-lustrous.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v22 — argument map

*yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś* Where the sun sets with the moon and all — that unconquered Śiva-night shines, self-light-spread-lustrous. Counter-cosmos: when all lights set, His night shines. (The 15.17 night-post, anticipated.)

chunks.l1:
## s04-v23 (23)
even / won / I / in-three / in-worlds / overlordship / O-king-of-gods / I-count / without / rasa / that / whole / being / foot / touch / nectar / by-rasa / devoid
chunks.l2: Even won rule in three worlds, O king of gods, I count tasteless — lacking Your foot-touch-nectar-rasa.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v23 — argument map

*apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam.* Even won rule in three worlds, O king of gods, I count tasteless — lacking Your foot-touch-nectar-rasa. Empire vs foot-touch: no contest.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v24 (24)
alas / O-Lord / strong / this / self / bond / being / non-fame / formed / by-You / indeed / fashioned / which / this / firstly / indeed / of-me / You / having-disregarded / loosens / not / by-a-bit / even
chunks.l2: Alas, Lord, strong is this self-bond, made of Your un-fame, fashioned by You alone — first ignored by me, it never loosens a bit.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v24 — argument map

*bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho.* Alas, Lord, strong is this self-bond, made of Your un-fame, fashioned by You alone — first ignored by me, it never loosens a bit. Bond made BY Him OF His unfamed-ness: the knot He tied. Held, not solved.

chunks.l1:
## s04-v25 (25)
of-the-great / O-king-of-gods / being-worshipped / even / not / night / you-stay / worshipper / one / formed / outside / inside / even / here / being-seen / you-shine / seer / embodied / indeed / forever
chunks.l2: Though worshipped by the great, O king of gods, You ever stay the one-worshipper-form — seen outside and in, You shine in the seers' bodies forever.
chunks.argmap:
## s04-v25 — argument map

*mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py.* Though worshipped by the great, O king of gods, You ever stay the one-worshipper-form — seen outside and in, You shine in the seers' bodies forever. Final inversion: the worshipped is the worshipper; He shines inside the seers, not above them.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v01 (1)
Your / foot / lotus / contact / mere / enjoyment / joined / in-neck / by-hold / O-Lord / me / own / house / lead-in
chunks.l2: Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v01 — argument map

*tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam.* Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house. Entry by touch, not merit; "by the neck" (*galepādikayā*) — force asked for.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v02 (2)
being / foot / lotus / dust / redness / dyed / head-hair / boundless / frenzy / begun / dancing / may-I-be / I / when
chunks.l2: Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance?
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v02 — argument map

*bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ.* Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance? Dust as dye; dance as the question's form. (Lakshmanjoo: holding His feet, wiping their dust.)

chunks.l1:
## s05-v03 (3)
You / sole-Lord / O-Lord / this-much / indeed / I-ask / always / You / within / dwelling / silent / may-I-be / not / otherwise / wise
chunks.l2: You my sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; otherwise, wise.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v03 — argument map

*tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā.* You my sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; otherwise, wise. Silence over wisdom: *mūka* (dumb) beats *budha* (clever). The anti-eloquence verse.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v04 (4)
ah / nectar / O-ocean / O-master / ah / sweet / O-three-eyed / ah / tasty / deformed / eyed / thus / indeed / may-I-dance / shouting
chunks.l2: Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v04 — argument map

*aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana.* Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting. Praise by exclamation; three *aho*s as liturgy.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v05 (5)
Your / foot / lotus / touch / half-closed / eyed / may-I-expand / being / devotion / liquor / madness / reeling
chunks.l2: Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v05 — argument map

*tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ.* Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness. Touch narrows sight, widens being.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v06 (6)
mind / mountain / on-earth / O-All-pervading / may-I-dwell / where / even / where / she / uninterrupted / Your / prattle / made-of / practice / great-rasa
chunks.l2: May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v06 — argument map

*cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā.* May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle. Dwelling defined by practice, not place.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v07 (7)
where / goddess / accompanied / you / from-palace / up-to / and / from-gate-tower / many / formed / standing / in-that / dweller-to-be / may-I-be / I / in-city
chunks.l2: Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v07 — argument map

*yatra devīsametas tvam.* Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell. The divine household as address; *bahurūpa* domesticated.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v08 (8)
may-they-rejoice / O-Lord / being / sun / rays / may-bloom / this / until / of-me / heart / lotus / for-worship / of-You
chunks.l2: May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v08 — argument map

*samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ.* May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship. Blooming as the rays' festival, not the devotee's work.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v09 (9)
be-gracious / O-Lord / by-which / Your / on-foot / fallen / always / mind / of-me / this / that / having-tasted / it-melts / as / it-flows / as
chunks.l2: Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — melts like wax, flows like...
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v09 — argument map

*prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā.* Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — melts like wax, flows like... Wax-mind: tasting melts; melting is the prayer.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v10 (10)
great / from-joy / or / and / sorrow / from / or / if / would-burst / from-pot / even / outer / from / and / inner / from / from-feeling / manifest / become / for-me / O-ruler

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v10 — argument map

*praharṣād vātha śokād vā.* Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord. Any trigger suffices; appear regardless of cause.

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v11 — argument map

*bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me.* Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always. Streaming touch, both directions.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v12 (12)
Your / foot / touch / nectar / from-lake / within / plunging / what / even / this / all / enjoyments / surpassing / pleasure / may-it-be / for-me / always
chunks.l2: Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v12 — argument map

*tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam.* Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always. Pleasure (*bhoga*) that surpasses (*laṅghī*) all pleasure.

chunks.l1:

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v13 — argument map

*niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā.* Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees. The passions cooked into nectar and shared: offering as cuisine.

## s05-v14 (14)
whole / world / food / ever / satisfied / happily / seated / O-master / accept / among-servants / grace / glance / moment

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v14 — argument map

*aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam.* Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants. The world-eater asked for one glance at servants.

inner / devotion / wonder / chewing / half-closed / eyed / bow / to-me / to-Śiva / thus / worshipping / may-I-be / straws / even

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v15 — argument map

*antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ.* Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw. Self as Śiva addressed; straw as liturgy-worthy.

chunks.l2: Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v16 — argument map

*api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ.* Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments. Gaining without leaving: enjoyment as non-parting's seal.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v17 (17)
to-be-desired / other / by-which / O-Lord / not / is-found / of-You / therefore / of-secondless / fitting / which / fullness
chunks.l2: Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v17 — argument map

*ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate.* Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting. Desire's end as fitness-proof.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v18 (18)
it-is-laughed / it-is-danced / where / passion / aversion / beginning-with / is-eaten / is-drunk / devotion / nectar / rasa / that / may-I-attain / place
chunks.l2: Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place.
chunks.argmap:
## s05-v18 — argument map

*hasyate nṛtyate yatra.* Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place. The festival as destination.

## s05-v19 (19)

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v19 — argument map

*tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā.* May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes. Fragrance vs stink: thought's smell decides.

## s05-v20 — argument map

chunks.l1:
## s05-v21 (21)
wandering / yoga / in-states / even / objects / turned-away / abiding / even / Your / thought / liquor / madness / fluidized / made / hearted / indeed / may-I-be

chunks.argmap:
## s05-v21 — argument map

*vicaran yogadaśāsv api.* Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness. States passed through, not dwelt in; melting only by Him.

chunks.l1:
## s05-v22 (22)

chunks.argmap:
